relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 20 verses reread in both pinned texts.
notes: Gen 12:1: emphatic departure construction retains lamed and pronominal suffix contextually.
Gen 12:2–3: source of blessing is an expansion of the noun blessing; distinct verbs for cursing retain their individual IDs.
Gen 12:4: numeral compound excludes the intervening year noun, which is retained in the separate age construction.
Gen 12:8–9: definite articles and directional suffixes distinguished by morphology; place-name components remain distinct IDs.
Gen 12:16 and 20: Hebrew possessive existence construction becomes French receive/belong; collective correspondences retained rather than inventing new individual senses.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
